text:
Maya P: quick idea //- we need a deterministic handshake for control-plane -> edge proxies when starting an evacuation so we avoid split-actions. proposing a "quiesce token" flow. thoughts?
Noah V: can you sketch the flow? is this a push from control plane or pull by proxy?
Maya P: push. control-plane posts /v2/evacuate/{region} with token and TTL. proxies ack and start a 3-stage sequence: PREPARE -> SOFT_DRAIN -> FORCE_REROUTE. each stage has idempotent marker and progress on status API.
Ivy S: sounds good. need to ensure per-tenant residency flags are respected during SOFT_DRAIN. some tenants can't go to remote regions. how do we surface that?
Maya P: control-plane will include residency_allowlist per-tenant-hash and fallback_policy: [REMOTE, QUEUE, REJECT]. proxies evaluate and report capability. if a tenant is REJECT-only, we mark it in the report and control-plane keeps local route (but marks tenant degraded).
Ravi K: operator concern: what if proxies lose connectivity mid-handshake? we should attach a lease and allow automatic rollback if not confirmed within TTL. also expose operator override: /v2/evacuate/{region}/force with justification header.
eng-prod: runbook snippet idea: step 1 check cluster health, step 2 post evacuate token, wait for >= 90% proxies ack or timeout, step 3 monitor routing-shift metrics (local_success_rate drop), step 4 if < threshold revert. we'll add alerts for slow ack rate.
ops-bot: runbook-bot: evacuation runbook updated (draft) at 2026-03-24T09:02Z.
Noah V: API contract suggestion: request body = {"token":"uuid","ttl":60,"stages":[{"name":"PREPARE","duration_s":20},{"name":"SOFT_DRAIN","duration_s":60}],"tenant_constraints_url":"signed://..."}. proxies respond with {"proxy_id","stage_status","tenant_block_list_count"}. keep payload small.
Ivy S: security: signed tokens only. tokens should be HMACed with region-specific key so a compromised control-plane credential in one region cannot issue cross-region evacuations. also log audit events to immutable store.
Maya P: routing switch semantics: during SOFT_DRAIN proxies should 1) stop accepting new primaries for tenants eligible for fallback, 2) finish in-flight requests, 3) start returning 302-style redirect header for caller SDKs to prefer remote endpoint (we might prefer in-proxy re-route for opaque clients).
Ravi K: for SDKless clients we need a transparent mode: proxy rewrites upstream routing header and forwards to remote region. tracking IDs must be preserved so KV/consistency layers can attribute writes. note: this implies cross-region TTL for tracing metadata.
Noah V: telemetry: emit evacuation_metrics{region,stage,ack_rate,blocked_tenants,pct_inflight}. create composite alert: avg(ack_rate) < 0.8 for 2m -> page.
Ivy S: compliance: blocked_tenants list is tenant hashes only, never PII. also proxies must not include sample payloads with residency=EU in telemetry outside EU. add a policy in the handshake: "residency_enforcement": true/false.
Maya P: edge case: overlapping evacuations (two regions evacuating). control-plane should use monotonic token generation and a precedence rule: evacuate with higher priority wins; proxies can concurrently be in different tokens but must surface last-writer-wins precedence.
Ravi K: failure modes: if proxy ack is delayed but routing already shifted, we could create doubled request paths. we should mark a safe-cutover window and track idempotency tokens on requests. SDKs can resend with idempotency-key.
eng-prod: canary plan: implement endpoint in staging, run simulated evacuations against 10% of proxies for 48h using replayed traces. validate metrics and rollback hooks.
Noah V: implementation detail: make handshake purely declarative so control-plane can PATCH /status with token instead of POST; proxies poll every 2s with jitter. push is faster but polling is simpler for flaky networks. maybe support both: push for low-latency, poll fallback for disconnected proxies.
Maya P: agreed. we can have `/v2/evacuate/subscribe` websocket for push and `/v2/evacuate/status` for poll. websocket auth via mTLS.
Ivy S: privacy table to include in RFC: what we store, for how long; e.g. token UUID (retained 7d), tenant_hashes (retained 24h), stage_logs (retained 72h), no request bodies.
Ravi K: operator API: `/v2/evacuate/{region}/status` returns cluster-wide aggregated view and per-proxy deltas. also allow `/v2/evacuate/{region}/cancel` with audit_reason. ops should be rate-limited and require 2FA.
eng-prod: alerts YAML draft for canary:
- name: evacuate_ack_rate_low
  expr: avg(evac_ack_rate{env="canary"}) < 0.8
  for: 120s
  labels:
    severity: page
- name: evacuate_blocked_tenants_high
  expr: sum(blocked_tenants_count{env="canary"}) > 50
  for: 300s
  labels:
    severity: ticket

Noah V: action items: Maya write RFC with API shapes and failure modes; Ivy add privacy & keys rotation checklist; Ravi wire operator APIs and idempotency key guidance; eng-prod schedule canary. I'll volunteer to implement the websocket subscription helper.
Maya P: will open RFC by EOD. thanks.
Ivy S: lgtm
Ravi K: lgtm
eng-prod: noted
